lines: n1
[epic movie-trailer voice, intense, low] FINAL day. [pause] The sky turns RED. [pause] Aliens... are HERE.
n2
[determined, rising] Humanity has ONE army left: [short pause] one MILLION Optimus robots.
n3
[shouting a battle cry, explosive] They CHARGE!
n4
[urgent, desperate] The ships are too BIG. [short pause] Lasers bounce OFF. [short pause] Robots fall by the THOUSANDS.
n5
[ominous, awed, slow] Then the MOTHERSHIP arrives. [short pause] TEN kilometers wide. [pause] Nothing on Earth can TOUCH it.
n6
[quiet, shocked] The robots STOP. [pause] Every... single... one.
n7
[whispering, tense] Did they just... give up?
n8
[sudden, powerful, sharp] NO. [pause] They were CALCULATING.
n9
[building intensity, faster] They start CLIMBING onto each other. [short pause] Arms LOCK. [short pause] Legs LOCK. [short pause] A MILLION machines,
[epic, triumphant, huge] becoming ONE. [pause] A GIANT [short pause] the size of a MOUNTAIN.
[awed, triumphant] And for the FIRST time, [short pause] the aliens... back AWAY.
[playful, challenging the viewer] Your move: [short pause] one GIANT robot, [short pause] or a MILLION small ones? [short pause] Which army WINS? [short pause] Comment below!
